arStrings.szText:
Removes the falling delay before {c_important}Meteor{/c} crashes down. 

{c_important}Meteor{/c} now deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} impact damage and {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEA_BURNING}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Meteor{/c} rains down {c_number}6{/c} Meteorites before the final impact that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_METEORITE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage each, but {c_important}Meteor{/c} no longer deals Burning damage.

{c_important}Meteor{/c} becomes a {c_important}Frost{/c} Skill that deals Cold damage.

{c_important}Meteor{/c} calls down an icy Comet that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_IMPACT_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_FROSTBITE}{/c} Frostbite and {c_number}{SF_24}%{/c} {u}{c_important}Chill{/c}{/u} over {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Meteor{/c} now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing {c_number}[SF_11 * 100 |x%|]{/c} increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.
{c_important}Meteor{/c} Immobilizes enemies for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADE2_IMMOBILIZE}{/c} seconds on impact.
{c_important}Meteor{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_13 * 100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and has {c_number}[SF_13 * 100|x%|]{/c} increased Size, but now also has a {c_number}[SF_14]{/c} second Cooldown.
{c_important}Meteor's{/c} Impact damage now grants {c_number}1{/c} stack of {u}{c_important}Overpower{/u}{/c} per enemy hit.
